candidates.name: IgG4-related disease
support_spans: Dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells, with most being IgG4 positive
Serum IgG4: 277 mg/dL (normal, <123 mg/dL)
candidates.why: The patient's elevated serum IgG4 levels and histopathologic findings of IgG4-positive plasma cells are consistent with IgG4-related disease.

candidates.name: Chronic rhinosinusitis
support_spans: Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation

candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of rhinorrhea, headache, and vision loss, along with imaging findings of sinus opacification and inflammation, are consistent with chronic rhinosinusitis.
